title: Walking catchments of six Blue Line stations, Riyadh Metro

headline.label: reachable on foot in 15 minutes from six stations

data: From OpenStreetMap through the Overpass API on 2026-11-20: the Blue Line relation (8857089) and its stop positions, and every walkable way in a box around the stations with a 0.013° (about 1.3 km) margin.
method: Pick six consecutive stations: STC, Al Wurud 2, Al Urubah, Al Inma Bank, Bank Al Bilad, King Fahad Library.
Build the pedestrian network with OSMnx, leaving out motorways and ways that are private or closed to pedestrians, and project it to UTM 38N.
Snap each station to the nearest network node (largest snap 85 m); the snap distance counts against the walking time.
Walking speed 4.8 km/h, so 80 m per minute: 400, 800 and 1,200 m along the network.
limits: This is an accessibility analysis that supports a transport study, not a traffic study or a traffic impact study; any study is signed by a licensed office. It ignores signal waits, sidewalk width, heat, slopes and the difficulty of crossing major roads, so results lean to an upper bound. Each station is its train stop position, not its entrances.
